tara (DR PM): Quick postgame: during the tabletop restore we hit a flaky cross-region snapshot read that added ~20m to the restore flow. Not total outage, but second time in 3 drills. Need concrete follow-ups (owners + tickets + dates).

leon (SRE): saw error logs that show S3 504s followed by k8s restart churn when the restore job retries. Pattern looks like: partial pod loss -> control-plane pressure -> delayed endpoint resolution -> snapshot client timeout.

priya (EngInfra): adding my notes: replication lag to the DR bucket sometimes spikes during snapshot create. also presigned url TTL is 1h which might be too short if retries backoff.

dave (Platform): we should separate short-term mitigations from longer changes. propose: short = runbook + canary restores; medium = presigned TTL and retry policy; long = fallback read-path (replica proxy).

tara (DR PM): tagging items here. please reply with owner + ETA and create a tracker ticket. I'll consolidate.

1) Runbook updates: explicit cross-region restore checklist, add verification steps and who-to-ping. owner: tara. ETA: 5d (2180700000).

leon (SRE): i'll own automated CI restore test (daily smoke against dr-test). owner: leon. ETA: 3d (2180400000). will add failure alerts to #incidents.

priya (EngInfra): 2) Snapshot client retry/backoff and presigned URL TTL bump to 4h, and add replication lag monitoring. owner: priya. ETA: 7d (2180850000).

3) Restore telemetry + circuit breaker: fail-fast when snapshot backend unavailable, surface readable error reasons. owner: dave. ETA: 4d (2180300000). will add Sentry tags + Console dashboard tile.

oncall-bot: checklist created: runbook_update(tara) | ci_restore(leon) | presigned_ttl(priya) | restore_cb(dave).

tara (DR PM): test matrix for runbook update (please include):
- smoke restore using last 24h snapshot across eu->us
- verify service-account creds and IAM role mapping for cross-region reads
- validate rollback path to warm cluster (no traffic cut)
- RTO target <= 20m for warm restore

leon (SRE): adding a minimal smoke script to repo. snippet:

```bash
# smoke restore for CI job
export SNAP_ID=$(rfctl list-snapshots --region eu-west-1 | head -n1 | awk '{print $1}')
rfctl restore --snapshot $SNAP_ID --region us-west-2 --target dr-ci-01 --wait 1200
```

priya (EngInfra): i'll instrument replication lag metric and alert if lag > 300s. also will open an infra ticket for presigned TTL change.

dave (Platform): will add circuit-breaker with exponential backoff (initial windows: 3 retries with 30s base). will canary to 5% of restores.

tara (DR PM): please paste ticket IDs after creation and owners. I'll keep the master tracker. Also add a short recurring incident pattern note: "restore latency spikes correlated with partial-pod-restarts + snapshot read timeouts".

leon (SRE): created ENG-DR-1400 (CI restore + alerts). https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-DR-1400

priya (EngInfra): created ENG-NET-2100 (presigned-ttl + replication metrics). https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-NET-2100

dave (Platform): created ENG-OPS-1999 (restore circuit-breaker + telemetry). https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-OPS-1999

tara (DR PM): created OPS-GD-60 (game-day: full cross-region restore drill). target date 2026-04-12 15:00 UTC. invite sent.

oncall-bot: All tickets linked: ENG-DR-1400 | ENG-NET-2100 | ENG-OPS-1999 | OPS-GD-60. Linked to incident 2180156000.

tara (DR PM): final asks: leon, include the CI job as a required pre-check in the runbook; priya, ensure IAM discovery step is explicit; dave, include Sentry playbook entry for common error codes.

leon (SRE): ack. will add to runbook and link PR.

priya (EngInfra): ack. I'll add IAM commands and verification steps.

dave (Platform): ack. will add error code -> remediation mapping in Sentry.

oncall-bot: last_message_by oncall-bot at 2180159000: thread tracked, next check-in scheduled in 7 days.
